schema.description: Response schema for multiple external users

items.description: This is an object representing a user synced from a connected external account (e.g., a Zoom user).

email.description: The email address of the user at the provider.

first_name.description: The first name of the user at the provider.

last_name.description: The last name of the user at the provider.

status.description: The status of the user at the provider. 'active' means the user is active, 'inactive' means the user is deactivated or suspended, 'pending' means the user has not yet activated their account. Additional values may be added over time.

items.title: ExternalUser

schema.title: ExternalUsersResponse
